# truenas_directoryservices (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS SCALE directory services configuration (directoryservices.config) and health (directoryservices.status). Takes no arguments: there is exactly one directory services configuration per TrueNAS system. Does not expose "credential": see the truenas_directoryservices resource documentation for why the credential used to join a domain is never readable back from TrueNAS.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `configuration_activedirectory` (Attributes) Active Directory join configuration, or null if not configured for Active Directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory))
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether directory services are currently enabled.
- `enable_account_cache` (Boolean) Whether backend caching for user and group lists is enabled.
- `enable_dns_updates` (Boolean) Whether automatic DNS updates via nsupdate/GSSAPI/TSIG are enabled.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "directoryservices".
- `kerberos_realm` (String) Name of the Kerberos realm used for authentication to the directory service.
- `service_type` (String) The directory service type currently configured, or null if never joined.
- `status` (String) Directory service status from the last health check: DISABLED, FAULTED, LEAVING, JOINING, or HEALTHY. Null if directory services are disabled.
- `status_msg` (String) Reason the directory service is FAULTED after a failed health check. Null if not faulted.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout (in seconds) for DNS queries and LDAP network requests.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration_activedirectory`

Read-Only:

- `computer_account_ou` (String) Organizational unit (OU) containing the TrueNAS computer account.
- `domain` (String) Full DNS domain name of the joined Active Directory domain.
- `enable_trusted_domains` (Boolean) Whether support for trusted domains is enabled.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the TrueNAS server registered in Active Directory.
- `site` (String) The Active Directory site where the TrueNAS server is located.
- `use_default_domain` (Boolean) Whether the domain prefix is removed from Active Directory user/group names.
